description:
Call any Microburbs endpoint. `endpoint` is a name from
`search_endpoints` (e.g. "suburbs_market_median_rent_series") or its
path ("/v1/suburbs/{suburb_name}/market/median-rent-series", or filled
in: "/v1/suburbs/Bondi/market/median-rent-series"). `params` holds the
path and query parameters by name, e.g. {"suburb_name": "Bondi"}.
Returns the endpoint's JSON, billed exactly as the REST call (see
`_cost_cents`); an unknown endpoint or parameter costs nothing.
name: call_endpoint
title: Call an endpoint
